description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CharacterCreation" name="Start character creation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start two activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ToNames</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ToAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Come_Up_Names" name="Come up with good character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToNames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Names_ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Has_Account" name="Has Battle.net account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasAccount_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Enter_Account_Info" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountInfo_ToConfirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Click_Confirmation_Link" name="Click confirmation link in mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountInfo_ToConfirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm_ToAccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Account_Merge" name="Battle.net account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasAccount_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm_ToAccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMerge_ToSubCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Check_Subscription" name="Check active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountMerge_ToSubCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubCheck_ToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription" name="Active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubCheck_ToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Subscription_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Subscription_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select_Payment_Method" name="Select payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Subscription_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_ToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Method" name="Payment method?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_ToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_BankAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Enter_Credit_Card" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_ToPaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Enter_IBAN_BIC" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_BankAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IBAN_ToPaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment details entered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_ToPaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IBAN_ToPaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_ToSubMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" name="Subscription ensured">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Subscription_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_ToSubMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubMerge_ToSetupJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Account setup and names ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubMerge_ToSetupJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Names_ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ToLogin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Log_Into_Game" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ToLogin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_ToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select_Realm_Race_Class" name="Select realm, race and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_ToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_ToNameMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Name_Merge" name="Name to check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_ToNameMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameTaken_Retry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameMerge_ToEnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Enter_Character_Name" name="Enter character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameMerge_ToEnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_ToAvailable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Name_Available" name="Name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_ToAvailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameTaken_Retry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Receive_Confirmation" name="Receive character creation confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_ToSelfies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Receive_Selfies" name="Receive selfies of character">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_ToSelfies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Selfies_ToExpansion</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Expansion_Released" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Selfies_ToExpansion</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Expansion_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_Expansion"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CharacterCreated" name="Character created and expansion message received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Expansion_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToSplit" sourceRef="Start_CharacterCreation" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToNames" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_Come_Up_Names"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Has_Account"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Names_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_Come_Up_Names" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Has_Account" targetRef="Gateway_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasAccount_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Has_Account" targetRef="Task_Enter_Account_Info"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountInfo_ToConfirm" sourceRef="Task_Enter_Account_Info" targetRef="Task_Click_Confirmation_Link"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_ToAccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_Click_Confirmation_Link" targetRef="Gateway_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_ToSubCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Account_Merge" targetRef="Task_Check_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubCheck_ToGateway" sourceRef="Task_Check_Subscription" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subscription_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subscription_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription" targetRef="Task_Select_Payment_Method"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_ToGateway" sourceRef="Task_Select_Payment_Method" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Method"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Method" targetRef="Task_Enter_Credit_Card"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_BankAccount" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Method" targetRef="Task_Enter_IBAN_BIC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_ToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Enter_Credit_Card" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IBAN_ToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Enter_IBAN_BIC" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_ToSubMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubMerge_ToSetupJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ToLogin" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Join" targetRef="Task_Log_Into_Game"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_ToSelect" sourceRef="Task_Log_Into_Game" targetRef="Task_Select_Realm_Race_Class"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_ToNameMerge" sourceRef="Task_Select_Realm_Race_Class" targetRef="Gateway_Name_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameMerge_ToEnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_Name_Merge" targetRef="Task_Enter_Character_Name"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_ToAvailable" sourceRef="Task_Enter_Character_Name" targetRef="Gateway_Name_Available"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameTaken_Retry" name="No, try next name" sourceRef="Gateway_Name_Available" targetRef="Gateway_Name_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Name_Available" targetRef="Task_Receive_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_ToSelfies" sourceRef="Task_Receive_Confirmation" targetRef="Task_Receive_Selfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selfies_ToExpansion" sourceRef="Task_Receive_Selfies" targetRef="Event_Expansion_Released"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expansion_ToEnd" sourceRef="Event_Expansion_Released" targetRef="End_CharacterCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
